summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. New file rdflib/extras/shacl.py provides parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass). Literals raise TypeError; all other failures raise SHACLPathError. New test module test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py has one parametrized test covering valid forms and every error branch, plus a graph-unchanged check. Verified: the new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the prepared venv. Not verified: black, ruff, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so lint and type gates were not run; line lengths and wrapping were checked by hand. Nothing committed; no core modules, __init__ files, or test/test_path.py changed.
